description: Preview accounts only: opens one locked firm's full record (overview, AUM as stored, decision-maker names and positions, philanthropy, news, events) and counts it toward the account's 10 preview records; a firm already opened counts nothing. Returns the record and the number of preview records left; when none are left it returns no_unlocks_left. On full-access accounts it returns the same result as get_investor. Work emails and LinkedIn profiles are not part of preview records.
